user.title: Connect to QLC+
user.description: QLC+ must run in web mode (`qlcplus -w`).

project.title: Upload project
project.description:
Connected to QLC+ {version}. Upload the project file (.qxw) that is loaded in QLC+. Fixture definitions that are not part of the QLC+ library can be uploaded as .qxf files.

{error}

mismatch.title: Project does not match QLC+
mismatch.description:
The uploaded project does not match the project that is loaded in QLC+: {details}.

Entities for functions or widgets that differ will not work as expected. Submit to continue anyway or go back and upload the matching project.

init.title: QLC+ options
init.description:
Choose the entity groups and polling interval, or upload a new project or fixture definitions. Entities are rebuilt afterwards.

{error}
